experimental_design: Affinity pulldown of mitoribosomal complexes from Diplonema papillatum, the diplonemid type species, demonstrates that they have a mass of > 5 MDa, contain as many as 130 integral proteins, and exhibit a protein-to-RNA ratio of 11:1.
number_of_technical_replicates: Single-step affinity purification (AP) was performed in quadruplicate as previously described for humans, with slight modifications.
technical_replicate: Single-step affinity purification (AP) was performed in quadruplicate as previously described for humans, with slight modifications.
technology_type: The HPLC system was coupled to Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) through a Nanospray Flex Ion Source.
